title: Agent Sociodrama: Social-Dynamics-Guided Persona Recasting for LLM Agent Teams
abstract: arXiv:2610.15788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as teams, yet they fail in characteristically social ways: information holders stay silent, dominant speakers anchor groups on wrong answers, and norm violations go unsanctioned. We present Agent Sociodrama, a framework for modeling and validating evolving social dynamics in LLM agent teams. Under fixed personas, agents' emotional states and directed, asymmetric relationships are updated every round by a unified external LLM judge and shape their subsequent interactions. Across six LLM backbones and five social scenarios, we assess social fidelity through classical social-theory patterns and agreement with human judgments. The resulting trajectories exhibit structured social patterns and model-specific differences. translated_title: 智能体社会剧：基于社会动态引导的LLM智能体团队角色重塑
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地以团队形式部署，然而它们会以典型的社会性方式失败：信息持有者保持沉默，强势发言者使群体锚定在错误答案上，违反规范的行为得不到制裁。我们提出了Agent Sociodrama（智能体社会剧），这是一个用于建模和验证LLM智能体团队中不断演变的社会动态的框架。在固定人设的前提下，智能体的情绪状态以及有向、非对称的关系由统一的外部LLM裁判每轮更新，并影响其后续交互。我们在六个LLM骨干模型和五个社会场景中，通过经典社会理论模式以及与人类判断的一致性来评估社会保真度。所产生的轨迹展现出结构化的社会模式以及模型特定的差异。随后，我们引入了轨迹引导的角色重塑（TPR）方法，该方法从交互记录和社会轨迹中诊断群体动态故障，并重塑（原文在此处截断，摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出了Agent Sociodrama框架来建模和验证LLM智能体团队中不断演变的社会动态，并引入轨迹引导的角色重塑（TPR）方法，通过诊断群体动态故障并重塑智能体角色，来修复智能体团队中典型的社会性失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Agent Sociodrama, a framework for modeling and validating evolving social dynamics in LLM agent teams, and introduces Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting (TPR), which diagnoses group-dynamic failures from interaction transcripts and recasts agent personas to address characteristically social failure modes.
